notes: Scenario 2. Surge's original harness (an Inspect eval) has no agent, so the fork adds a solver that launches Claude Code exactly as Harbor 0.25.0 does: the same linux-arm64 binary (sha256-checked, bind-mounted read-only), env vars, setup and command. Both sides: claude-code@2.1.311 with claude-haiku-4-5; judge gemini-3.5-flash with Surge's rubric prompt, one call per rubric point; all through the 2077AI API; one task at a time per side. Model ID: the API only serves the undated alias claude-haiku-4-5 (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 returns model_not_found), and both sides used it on the same days. Subset: 30 of the 99 tasks, 3 per domain, sampled with random.Random(0) over the domains in sorted order (`--split parity`). Metrics are Surge's two: mean_criteria is the mean over tasks of the fraction of rubric points passed; all_pass is the share of tasks that pass every point. Runs: run 1 on 2026-11-15, runs 2 and 3 on 2026-11-16; 90 task-runs per side, 0 errors. Order: 5-task sanity check on both sides, then 3 runs on both sides. Not counted: a 5-task sanity check and a first full run (stopped at original 33/99, Harbor 36/99) on 2026-11-13/14, where the original side still used Inspect's own Claude Code wrapper (about 40% more tokens). It was replaced by the Harbor-identical launch, which passed its own 5-task sanity check (one earlier attempt failed to start its container). Checks: re-grading Harbor's run-1 answers with Surge's own scorer gave 64.89% vs 64.60% from Harbor's grader, with 98.2% of rubric points (449/457) getting the same verdict. The original side's agent cost was 0.85-0.92x Harbor's because of prompt-cache misses at the API proxy; turns, tool calls and settings match. Harbor 0.25.0 (commit fdba28fc411e47e8765420a1a063b4918fce3def). Grader: these runs graded inside the agent's container; afterwards the verifier moved to a separate container (environment_mode = "separate"), which is what the adapter ships. Parity was not re-run after that change (only the oracle was, 99/99). What the agent sees is unchanged and no parity trajectory touched the grader's files, so the results should carry over. Artifacts: the parity-experiments repo is over the Hub's file limit, so the files are in PranavVashistha/gdp-pdf-parity-experiments at revision 5a998002fb36cee50b15d695ffe1344cb90b5a13 until #285 can take them.
